policy.quote: one paired hypothetical YES best-bid/best-ask quote per stable exchange per 30-second receipt-time slot
policy.initialQueueAhead: all displayed top-level quantity at the quote price
policy.displayedIncreases: add each observed same-price top-level increase to an observed queue-ahead proxy; snapshots can miss intervening additions
policy.displayedReductions: never reduce queue ahead for displayed-size decreases; no cancellation is treated as a trade
policy.tradeSide: not inferred; captured trade reports have no aggressor side and sequence comparison does not establish queue-side attribution; trade id and sequence are retained as distinct fields
policy.fillRule: no print is allowed to decrement queue or confirm a fill without a supported aggressor-side/queue relationship

split.order: all development prefixes replayed before the holdout prefix; policy fixed in code and no fitting, selection, or tuning occurs

sequenceDiagnostic.interpretation: saved-field comparability audit only. No common trade/book ordering guarantee, aggressor side, or consumed queue is established; sequence values never create or decrement a fill.
sequenceDiagnostic.previousBookRelationDefinition: last earlier captured valid book for the same exchange since the latest topic-wide lifecycle/revision boundary; per-exchange dirty hints do not erase this descriptive historical snapshot, and no continuity is implied

queueAheadSnapshots.aggregateMethod: exact row and unique-id counts; exact safe-integer sum/min/max for each declared metric

limitations: Captured trade rows carry price, quantity, execution time and a sequence/id, but no aggressor side; the capture contract does not document a sequence join that proves a trade consumed the displayed bid or ask queue.

A sequence audit found that no trade in the three frozen prefixes was exactly one sequence after its immediately preceding captured book point; current same-batch book sequence was greater than every trade sequence. This is descriptive only and does not establish a shared ordering domain or aggressor side.
Book snapshots do not expose order IDs or queue priority, and continuity between snapshots cannot prove that all intervening cancellations, additions, and executions are known.
Observed same-price size increases are conservatively added, while observed decreases are ignored; unseen intermediate changes mean the displayed queue-ahead proxy is not a full queue history.
Same-price print reports are shown only as unknown-side observations. They do not reduce queue-ahead shares and are not fill proxies.
Every 1s/5s/30s outcome cell is empty because no queue fill can be established from these archived fields; fees/stress and P&L are therefore not estimable.
Quote observations and unknown-side print counts are descriptive, clustered by market for coverage only; no outcome uncertainty interval or profitability claim is available.

interpretation: This replay records hypothetical touch quotes and timestamped displayed queue-ahead proxies only. It confirms no passive fills and yields no P&L or profitability estimate.

Touch-price trade reports are unknown-side observations and do not decrement queue or proxy a fill. Queue reductions are treated as possible cancellations and ignored; observed size increases are added, but missing snapshots can hide intermediate changes.

All prespecified 1s, 5s and 30s markout cells are reported as empty because no queue fill can be causally confirmed. One-tick stress is declared, but no stressed return can be calculated without fills/outcomes.
Historical captures are local read-only inputs. This run made no API requests and did not access runtime accounts or orders.
persistedDetailLevel: compact_summary; full timestamped queue rows remain on the in-memory replay result
